title: Mixed Event — SEKAI Happy New Year! — Episode7 The Strongest Team?

meta.Event Outline: Celebrate the New Year with Miku and the others in SEKAI! Get ready for a special episodic story featuring all group members!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's the match...!
Len and Rin win!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're the best teammate in the world, Rin!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Well, we lost....
But you guys are good at this!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, you were both really amazing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? You're one to talk, An! Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That got pretty exciting.
Shiraishi and Azusawa put up a good fight.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't tell me you want to play now too...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hmm, I wonder why Akito is so against it.
Are you worried about losing?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?! N-No, it's not like that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Then why don't you play?
It might be more fun than you think!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, I may not be very good, but I'd really like to give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine, fine! Like I have a choice at this point...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great! Len and Rin, your new challengers are Akito and Toya!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, you dragged me into this so we better win...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Man, we lost by ONE point...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Akito. It was my fault...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You were so busy helping me out, it kept you from doing more...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Nah, you're overthinking it.
I mean, it's just a game.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You really went in hard at the end for something that's just a game.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Regardless of the outcome, I had a lot of fun. Thanks, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, I suppose it's fine then.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Well played, everyone!
I brought you your drinks.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO, I wouldn't want you to miss out on this. Would you like to play a round of Hanetsuki too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why not? To be honest, after seeing everyone else have so much fun, I feel like playing now too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do it! It'll be you two against us!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We've got a perfect track record so far! Once we beat you, we'll be the undisputed champions!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be the referee this time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We'll play by the same rules as before. Five points to win. You score one point if the opposing team fails to hit the shuttlecock.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You hit it just where I wanted it, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa, what?!
How did she get that one?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I was studying your movements while I was refereeing your previous matches.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, do you want to give up now or keep playing until I completely cover your faces with ink?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We're not giving up!
It's my turn to serve!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're good, Rin, but can you hit THIS?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What the...?!
Now we're two points behind...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Maybe I'm feeling more motivated because I have you as my teammate, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We can still recover from this...! We'll beat you guys and claim the title of undisputed champions!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah! It's too soon to give up!
Let's do this, Len!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're getting really fired up now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah. But we're not going easy on them...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We only scored one point too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Miku, MEIKO, you two were unreal!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks, An. And thank you, Rin and Len, for a fun match!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It was fun...
But I really wanted to win...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
C'mon, that's no way to start the new year.
You did your best and that's what matters.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You definitely showed everyone that you're an amazing duo.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, enough about that. After a little break, wanna do a gig together to kick off the new year?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone's here, so I thought it'd be cool if we did one together. Would you be up for it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd love to! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too! What should we sing? Len, can you be the DJ while I sing with them! We can swap after that and...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And just like that, they're back to their usual, cheerful selves.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, that's Rin and Len for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And so begins another great year filled with friendly rivalries.
